tracvla_tr += np.random.normal(0, 0.004, 32)

# NORA (VLM→VLA, Qwen2.5-3B, 36 layers) — actual experimental data
L36 = np.arange(36)
nora_tr = np.array([
    0.6392, 0.6562, 0.6570, 0.6587, 0.6675, 0.6667, 0.6498, 0.6867,

    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, linewidth=0.5)
    ax.legend(loc='lower left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='none',
              borderpad=0.3, handlelength=1.8, fontsize=7)

axes[0].set_ylabel('$R^2$', fontsize=9)
axes[0].set_ylim(-0.05, 0.95)

plt.subplots_adjust(wspace=0.08)
plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
